messages.subject: statet can not find cygwin R
messages.subject_clean: statet can not find cygwin R
messages.body_plain:
Dear StatET users,

Previously I used R (v3.1.2) for Windows (binary package from R-project) and StatET (v3.4.1) for Eclipse (v4.4.0), they worked without issue. But when I changed to the cygwin version (v2.870) of R (v3.1.3, installed directly from pre-built cygwin packages), StatET can not recognize the R installation. Is it because StatET does not support the cygwin version of R? Could anyone give any hints? Thanks in advance.
